newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up on run cuts, U.K. tax hike play.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up on run cuts, U.K. tax hike play.

text.p: NWE gasoline futures were firm on Thursday on a combination of refinery run cuts and speculation about the possibility of tax hikes on gasoline by Britain's new Labour government.
Eurograde barges traded at $203.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam for delivery to June 5 in early trade, but a number of traders deemed this number as rather high.
Bids and offers for the rest of the day were pegged around $201.50/$203.
Traders attributed gasoline's strength to run cuts at Texaco's Nerefco refinery in Rotterdam.
